schemaNotes: schema=2 adds `tier`, `agents`, `commands`, `hooks` (script count), `mcp`, `memory`, `rules` fields to every platform entry, and expands coverage from 4 entries (claude/codex/gemini/shared) to all 15 deployed platforms. Pre-existing fields (skills, hookEvents, skillsPath, hooksPath) are retained on tier-1 entries that the drift checker (scripts/check-platform-drift.js) validates against disk. Tier-2/3 entries omit skillsPath/hooksPath because the drift checker only enforces parity for tier-1 surfaces with a deploy-counted directory on disk.

tiers.first-class: Native plugin surface: skills + agents + commands + hooks scripts + MCP. Local picker + templates as files. (claude, codex, gemini)
tiers.mcp-plus-hooks: MCP + Python plugin tree + shared skills (copy-from shared/) + at least one wired hook. (hermes, wayland)
tiers.mcp-plus-rules: MCP config + rules/instructions file only. No skills, no hooks, no commands, no agents on disk. (cursor, windsurf, copilot, antigravity)
tiers.mcp-only: MCP config merge only. No rules file deployed by installer. (opencode, qwen, cline, kimi, openclaw)
tiers.rules-only: Rules/conventions file only. No MCP (Aider has no native MCP client). (aider)

codex.notes: codex/.agents/plugins/marketplace.json is an empty placeholder; no agent .md files on disk. Team Assembly generates project agents at runtime (verified) but no platform-shipped agent templates.

gemini.notes: Richest hook surface of any platform (11 events including BeforeModel/AfterModel/PreCompress/Notification). gemini/extensions/ijfw/agents/ holds only a .gitkeep placeholder; the installer ships 0 agent templates.

shared.notes: Source library for skill bodies copied verbatim into hermes/ and wayland/ user dirs by installer.

cursor.notes: Project-scoped install: .cursor/mcp.json + .cursor/rules/ijfw.mdc + .cursorrules. No skills, hooks, commands, or agents on disk. Picker reached through ijfw_memory_recall via MCP.

windsurf.notes: Home-scoped MCP (~/.codeium/windsurf/mcp_config.json) + project-scoped .windsurfrules. Same MCP-fallback path as cursor.

copilot.notes: Project-scoped: .vscode/mcp.json + .github/copilot-instructions.md. MCP is project-scoped, not home-scoped.

hermes.notes: Skills sourced from shared/skills/ (19 files, copy-if-absent). 6 commands declared in plugin.yaml as Python handlers (cross-audit, cross-research, cross-critique, workflow, handoff, compress). One hook wired (pre_tool_use_extension_check.py) — plugin.yaml declares 6 hook capabilities but only 1 is delivered.

wayland.notes: Sibling implementation of Hermes (Hermes plugin.yaml literally says 'delegates to Wayland plugin source'). Same shared-skill set, same single tier-2 extension-check hook, same 5-of-6-declared hook gap.

opencode.notes: Installer only merges ~/.config/opencode/opencode.json (mcp.local schema). No rules file copied. No repo dir.

qwen.notes: Installer only merges ~/.qwen/settings.json (standard mcpServers shape). No rules file. No repo dir.

cline.notes: Installer writes into VS Code globalStorage for saoudrizwan.claude-dev. Opt-in pending live VS Code runtime verification.

kimi.notes: Installer only merges ~/.kimi/mcp.json (standard mcpServers shape). No rules file. No repo dir.

openclaw.notes: Installer prefers 'openclaw mcp set' CLI when on PATH; falls back to direct ~/.openclaw/openclaw.json merge (nested mcp.servers shape).

aider.notes: No native MCP client; rules-only install (~/.aider.conf.yml + ~/CONVENTIONS.md). Aider users do NOT have access to the IJFW memory layer at runtime.

antigravity.notes: Google's VS Code-fork agentic IDE, built by the ex-Windsurf team. Home-scoped MCP merge into ~/.gemini/antigravity/mcp_config.json (schema identical to Windsurf). Agent context inherited via the shared AGENTS.md convention -- no Antigravity-specific rules file. No skills, hooks, commands, or agents on disk.
